assumptions.choice: Detect Inverse Head & Shoulders on daily bars using a swing pivot window N=5. Require 3 consecutive swing lows (Head lower than Left and Right Shoulders) and 2 intermediate peaks forming the Neckline, triggering on an upward close breakout above the projected Neckline.
assumptions.reason: Provides a precise, objective algorithmic pattern detection without lookahead bias.

assumptions.choice: Aggregate daily bars into weekly bars, calculate 14-period Wilder RSI, and detect positive divergence when the most recent weekly low price is lower than a prior weekly trough while its RSI is higher.
assumptions.reason: Translates the specification's weekly RSI positive divergence requirement into a computable signal from daily data.

assumptions.choice: Define monthly trend as bullish when the current monthly close is above the 10-month SMA of monthly closes (or previous month close if history is less than 10 months).
assumptions.reason: Implements an objective higher-timeframe trend filter as mandated by the prompt.

assumptions.choice: Risk per trade is set to 2% of total capital, calculating share size as int((capital * 0.02) / (entry_price - stop_loss)), capped by available cash.
assumptions.reason: Adheres to the spec requirement that potential loss at stop-loss does not exceed 1-2% of total trading capital.

assumptions.choice: Set stop-loss at the Right Shoulder lowest value and take-profit at 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio relative to executed entry price, monitored on intra-bar daily High/Low.
assumptions.reason: Matches the exact stop-loss level and risk-to-reward parameters specified.
